scope: Two exposed development edits; objective ablation, not fresh method confirmation
supports: Exact saved consensus occurrence lists; new fits start with zero deltas
optimizer: Adam lr.001, fixed50 updates, no early stopping, BF16 deltas
selection_precision: Use actual sequentially merged FP16 model, not live hooks. Save answer-window calibration logits and target log probabilities; recompute KL in CPU float64. Live-hook final metrics retained separately.
objective: Existing max token/prompt NLL + mean prefix KL + repetition + .1 joint delta norm; add weight times mean full-vocabulary KL(base||edited) at three other-subject base-generated answer windows (first up to4 predictions). Mean over positions within each prompt, then equal mean over three prompts.
selection_rule: Choose smallest positive weight whose FINAL max target-token/prompt NLL <= -log(.9) and max calibration-token KL <= .1 in BOTH cases. Use no generated evaluation outputs. No qualifying weight => no selected candidate.
advance_criterion: Selected weight must retain 2/2 original prefixes, >=5/6 untrained-wording prefixes and lose at most 1 versus fixed50 weight0; new evaluation-target leakage <=1/8 and <=half of weight0, with a strict decrease; no additional lost baseline-reference or global-utility prefixes. All outputs reviewed. Prefix-count success alone is not a recipe or superiority claim.
input_selection: First exact-template matches, calibration indices256..383 (3/case), evaluation384..511 (4/case); exclude prior scope probes, edited subjects and prepared fresh-bank subjects. No output filtering. >=512 and fresh edit bank remain uninferred.
limitations: Small exposed facts; source labels unverified and can be ambiguous; base-distribution preservation is not factual correctness. Alias issues reported separately, frozen scoring unchanged. No mean-gradient/strong low-rank comparator here; those remain required before a method claim.
prediction: Answer-position preservation should reduce leakage on calibration subjects; unseen-subject transfer is uncertain. Failure to preserve both target learning and scope may indicate support capacity or generalization limits, not just an insufficient penalty.
